blocks.heading: How to Submit a Request
blocks.lead: The standard process for services that require document submission.
items: Download and fully complete the form
Submit documents by email, post, or in person
Staff review and respond within 15 business days
Receive the reply through the channel you specified

items.q: How do I ask an academic question?
items.a: Send your question through the contact form or the public-services channel — staff will coordinate with the relevant expert and respond within 15 business days.

items.q: How do I request permission to use content?
items.a: Submit a request stating your intended use through the content-permission service.
